name: Daily budget
when: An agent with a daily allowance. Once today's spending reaches the cap, it waits for tomorrow.

name: Budget with a ceiling
when: A daily budget, and no single payment above 100 USD₮0 even if someone raises the cap.

name: Spread it out
when: One payment can't eat more than half of the day's budget, so a single bad call can't empty it.

name: Payee book with a trial
when: Saved payees only. A payee saved today can get a small test payment, not the full invoice.

name: Strict payee book
when: Nothing goes to a payee until its cooling-off is over. No test payments.

name: Trust grows with time
when: Small payments to any saved payee; anything over 10 USD₮0 only to payees saved at least a week ago.

name: Zero tolerance
when: The first payment to a stranger blows the breaker. Everything stops until you reset it.

name: One mistake allowed
when: A first payment to a stranger is refused and counted. A second one blows the breaker.

name: Two of three sign big ones
when: Payments up to the threshold go through; above it, two of three approvers sign that exact payment.

name: Lead approver
when: Above the threshold, the lead approver (seat 1) and one other must sign.

name: Approvals with a ceiling
when: Two of three sign above the threshold, and nothing over 200 USD₮0 goes out, signed or not.

name: No double payments
when: The same payment (payee and amount) twice inside the window is stopped, unless you clear it once.

name: Never twice
when: A repeat inside the window is always stopped. No override, not even by you.
